comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text:
Implemented workflow/ruleset alignment for protected-branch semantic release.

- Replaced the inline `.github/workflows/release.yml` job with reusable `AnthusAI/platform-ci/.github/workflows/semantic-release-reusable.yml@main`.
- Passed caller inputs/secrets to match Virtuus pattern (`checkout_ref` from workflow_run SHA, `ANTHUSBOT_GH_TOKEN`, `PYPI_TOKEN`).
- Added guard conditions (`event == push`, same-repo check, `main` branch, `actor != anthusbot`) and release concurrency lock.
- Added `anthusbot` bypass actor to `infra/github-rulesets/main-branch-protection.json` so ruleset sync preserves bypass behavior for release pushes.

Validation:
- `python -m json.tool infra/github-rulesets/main-branch-protection.json` passed.
- Workflow lint skipped locally because `actionlint` is not installed.
